page.layout: One page of text, one column; running head "DEDICATIO." centred above the text; no margin notes; page signature "* 4" at the foot.
page.notes: The running head "DEDICATIO." is a title line at the top and is kept as the running head. The catchword "il-" is a word broken at the line end, partly printed at the foot after the signature "* 4". Some letters in the scan are damaged (e.g. "Gelrianata" spacing, "Gymnasii" rendered as "Gymnasii"), transcribed as seen. The final hyphen in "e-" and "ma-" line ends is retained as printed. Faint marks at the edges of the scan are not transcribed.
